scientific_integrity: The infinite classification follows from a stated marked-Poisson extreme-value argument, a uniform lower-workload cutoff, and a separate many-competitor argument. Finite consistency checks and numerical simulations do not certify an infinite claim or historical priority. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact stretched-exponential Weibull workloads with fixed shape 0<beta<1; independent jobs; integer-ceiling service-phase counts; independent rate-one exponential service phases. The asymptotic index-agreement theorem is not a theorem about random-walk drawdown excursions, and no universality or convergence rates are established. The displayed critical integral is exact while its decimal value is numerical.
title: A half-shape ranking transition for Weibull workloads under Gamma service clocks
